items.name: Lay Brother's Charm
items.lore: A wooden cross on a cord. The Faithful give one to every friend of the abbey.

items.name: White Cord of Vetusta
items.lore: The true brothers' cord - white, knotted three times.

items.name: Psalter-Chain Torc
items.lore: A thin chain that once held a psalter to a lectern.

items.name: Cloister-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Set with a chip of the cloister's old stone.

items.name: Mantle of the Bell-Ringer
items.lore: White wool, with Vetusta's bell in grey. Only the Bell-Ringers of Vetusta wear it.
